title: Diamond Head hike
notes: Iconic crater-rim hike over Waikiki; go before the heat. Walkable/rideshare distance from the hotel.
reservation_rule: Non-residents must reserve at gostateparks.hawaii.gov — 30-day booking window; sunrise slots go fast

title: Waikiki Beach + surf lesson/outrigger
notes: Beach day at the home base; outrigger canoe rides from the beach stands.
reservation_rule: Book a surf lesson 1–2 days ahead

title: Honolulu Zoo/Waikiki Aquarium
notes: Easy walkable pair at the Diamond Head end of Waikiki.

title: KCC Farmers Market
notes: Saturday-morning market at Kapiolani Community College, right below Diamond Head.

title: USS Arizona Memorial
notes: No bags allowed (paid bag storage on site).
reservation_rule: Recreation.gov — the standard 56-day window has PASSED for this trip; next-day tickets released daily 3pm HST, or line up for morning standby

title: Pearl Harbor full site (Missouri/Bowfin/Aviation)
notes: Battleship Missouri is the parents' favorite; paid combo tickets; adds 3–5h on top of the Arizona Memorial.

title: Iolani Palace
notes: The only royal palace in the US.

title: Chinatown food crawl
notes: Graze the markets and lunch counters — pairs with Maguro Brothers in Maunakea Marketplace.

title: Bishop Museum
notes: Best Hawaiian/Polynesian history museum on the islands — the rainy-day backup.

title: Tantalus/Puu Ualakaa lookout
notes: Sweeping city view steps from the car — zero walking; gate closes ~7:45pm in summer.

title: Manoa Falls
notes: Muddy jungle trail; $7 parking.

title: Hanauma Bay
notes: Best snorkeling on the island. Parking is $3/vehicle, cash only, and NOT included in the reservation — the lot fills, so go early. Last entry ~1:30pm.
reservation_rule: Online reservations open exactly 2 days ahead at 7am HST and sell out in minutes — $25/pp ages 13+; walk-in line from 6:45am as backup

title: Halona Blowhole + Lanai Lookout
notes: Roadside pull-offs on the coastal drive — no walking.

title: Sandy Beach (watch only)
notes: Dangerous shorebreak — watch the bodyboarders, do NOT swim.

title: Makapuu Lighthouse trail
notes: Paved 2mi round trip, no shade; car break-ins common — leave nothing visible; parents can turn around partway.

title: Koko Head stairs
notes: 1,048 railway-tie steps straight up — not for parents.

title: Sea Life Park
notes: Marine park below Makapuu; also hosts the Ka Moana luau.

title: Kailua + Lanikai Beach
notes: Lanikai has NO parking — park at Kailua Beach Park and walk or bike over.

title: Kailua town
notes: Boutiques + lunch spots a short hop from the beach.

title: Nuuanu Pali Lookout
notes: Huge windward view steps from the car; $7/vehicle non-resident parking (residents free); open 6am–6pm.

title: Byodo-In Temple
notes: Peaceful replica Japanese temple in the Valley of the Temples; small admission — bring cash to be safe; quiet respect.

title: Hoomaluhia garden drive
notes: Free botanical-garden drive under the Koolau cliffs; closes 4pm; no stopping on the entrance road.

title: Kualoa Ranch
notes: Jurassic Park valley — pick a tour (movie sites, e-bike, boat); tours run ~2–3h.
reservation_rule: Tours book out 2–4+ weeks ahead — check availability IMMEDIATELY

title: Chinaman's Hat viewpoint
notes: Free roadside viewpoint at Kualoa Regional Park.

title: Polynesian Cultural Center
notes: Villages + optional luau + evening show (ends ~9pm, home ~10pm); parents can skip the show and leave at 6. Only Thu/Fri/Sat work this trip.
reservation_rule: Book tickets/packages ahead — closed Sun + Wed

title: Laie Point
notes: Quick, dramatic sea-arch lookout.

title: Dole Plantation
best_time: Mid-morning en route to the North Shore
notes: Dole Whip + pineapple train; timebox it.

title: Haleiwa town + Matsumoto Shave Ice
notes: Surf-town stroll; expect a line at Matsumoto.

title: Laniakea Turtle Beach
notes: Keep 10ft back from the turtles.

title: Waimea Bay + Waimea Valley
notes: Late Aug = summer-flat, swimmable Bay (lot fills by 10am). Valley = paid garden walk to a swimmable waterfall — admission ~$26.50 adult / ~$21 senior, shuttle available for parents.

title: Sharks Cove snorkel
notes: Rocky entry — bring water shoes.

title: Sunset Beach/Pipeline
notes: Classic sunset finish to a North Shore day.

title: Ko Olina Lagoons
notes: Four calm man-made lagoons — the easiest swim for the parents.

title: Luau night (pick one)
notes: Options: Chief's Luau or Paradise Cove (Ko Olina — sunset oceanfront) · Ka Moana at Sea Life Park (East side, closer) · Waikiki Starlight or Diamond Head Luau (in Waikiki — no-car night).
reservation_rule: Book this week — luaus sell out
